The H d0; CCX d0 p d1; CX d1 t; CCX d0 p d1; H d0 witness remains rejected because t has such a path.

summary: Accept. The round-5 diff from round 4 changes only the status header and records maintainer ratification of K64 and K65; it introduces no semantic change and no regression. Previous round had no blocking issues, so there are no previous blockers to close. Re-reading the full snapshot against the north star and the 0.8 ISA found no S0 core or contract issue: the step machine and its inverse, F_B and commit, lproc binding instances, coherent control, borrow frames, cleanup discipline, identity envelopes, schedule selection, claim replay and host-limit handling are each given one normative reading, and deferred items keep their capabilities through stated defaults or explicit constructions.
